about: Preferred terms. verify warns when public question text (context, question, options, feedback, explanation, figure caption) matches an 'avoid' pattern (Python regex, case-insensitive), and a test holds the glossary, topic titles and figure labels to the same rules. Prefer the book's own word unless decided otherwise, and add a rule when the bank starts mixing two forms of the same thing.

rules.why: the book's word for the transmitter's final stage; the glossary entry says it is also called effektforsterker or PA
